sentences.text: BHAVADU
@ TINGRYA
@ DINESH

RAMESH PAWAR (PATIL)
 VERSUS  THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA AND ANOTHER

...
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr.Mukul S. Kulkarni  APP for Respondent-State : Mr.D.J.Patil  Advocate for Respondent no.2 : Mrs.Smita Chole Kendre  ...
 WITH  CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1000 OF 2024  ...
 CORAM : ARUN R. PEDNEKER, J.
 DATE : 09.07.2025 P.C. :
1] The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since last 6 years.

He further submits that the applicant is convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376-AB of the IPC and to suffer rigorous imprisonment for twenty years and to pay fine of Rs.25,000/- (Rs.Twenty Five Thousand only), in default of payment of fine, he is further sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for one month.
He further submits that the allegation against the applicant is that on 29.07.2019, the applicant committed forceful sexual intercourse on the victim, aged 6 years and 10 months.

He further submits that 4594.24APPLN medical evidence indicates that there were injuries on vagina and the Doctor has given opinion that such type of injuries are possible, either by penetrating intercourse or by use of finger.
He further submits that the victim had given statement under Section 164.
However, the victim has not deposed before the Court.

He further submits that the sister of the victim has stated in her statement that one person came on motorcycle and it requires two minutes to reach her home by walk from the place where she was dropped.
He further submits that within two minutes, the offence as alleged probably may not be possible.
He submits that in the facts and circumstances of the case, he has all arguable case.
The applicant is in custody since last 6 years and the appeal may not be heard in near future, therefore, the substantive sentence be suspended.
